intuition: A formula contains two operands, each of which is either a number or a reference to a stored cell value.

brute_force.approach: Store a full grid and parse each expression while evaluating its two terms.
brute_force.time: setCell O(1), resetCell O(1), getValue O(1)

optimal.approach: Store only nonzero cell values and parse the two formula operands on demand.
optimal.time: setCell O(1), resetCell O(1), getValue O(1)

edge_cases: A formula can add two cell values or a cell and a literal.
